lab.quote: Our Lote facility had received the USFDA’s Establishment Inspection Report, EIR, with a Voluntary Action Indicated classification following the surprise inspection conducted in February 2026.

call_memory.quote: Our Lote facility had received the USFDA’s Establishment Inspection Report, EIR, with a Voluntary Action Indicated classification following the surprise inspection conducted in February 2026.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Supriya Lifescience received USFDA EIR with Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classification for its Lote facility following an inspection in February 2026.

lab.quote: During Q4, industry-wide headwinds arose from geopolitical challenges, including supply chain disruptions, elevated crude and solvent prices and intermittent shortages, which impacted our Q4 FY26 revenue by INR10 crores.

call_memory.quote: During Q4, industry-wide headwinds arose from geopolitical challenges, including supply chain disruptions, elevated crude and solvent prices and intermittent shortages, which impacted our Q4 FY26 revenue by INR10 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Geopolitical challenges and supply chain disruptions, including elevated crude and solvent prices, impacted Q4 FY26 revenue by INR 10 crore.

lab.quote: We iterate our guidance of approximately 20% annual growth revenue and EBITDA margin, 33% to 35%.

call_memory.quote: We iterate our guidance of approximately 20% annual growth revenue and EBITDA margin, 33% to 35%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management reiterates annual revenue growth guidance of approximately 20% and EBITDA margin guidance of 33% to 35%.

lab.quote: Hence, we have decided to continue with the development. It is expected to be launching H2 financial year '27.

call_memory.quote: Hence, we have decided to continue with the development. It is expected to be launching H2 financial year '27.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Contrast media product launch is expected in H2 FY27 after process enhancements.

lab.quote: The total capex earmarked for this facility is around INR200 crores for Phase 1.

call_memory.quote: The total capex earmarked for this facility is around INR200 crores for Phase 1.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Supriya Lifescience plans Phase 1 development at Patalganga land starting in FY27 with an earmarked capex of around INR 200 crore over 2 years.

lab.quote: Our trajectory towards the INR1,000 crores revenue milestone by financial year '27 remains firmly on track, underpinned by a robust pipeline.

call_memory.quote: Our trajectory towards the INR1,000 crores revenue milestone by financial year '27 remains firmly on track, underpinned by a robust pipeline.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management targets reaching INR 1,000 crore revenue by FY27.

lab.quote: However, the growth won't be linear across the quarter as we have scheduled our annual maintenance shutdown in August for our older blocks A&D.

call_memory.quote: However, the growth won't be linear across the quarter as we have scheduled our annual maintenance shutdown in August for our older blocks A&D.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Growth will not be linear across quarters due to a scheduled annual maintenance shutdown in August 2026 for older blocks A and D.

lab.quote: Our capex for FY26 at INR152 crores, largely driven by spend on Ambernath facility along with maintenance capex and smaller projects, including the Ribo Block and formulation plant requirements.

call_memory.quote: Our capex for FY26 at INR152 crores, largely driven by spend on Ambernath facility along with maintenance capex and smaller projects, including the Ribo Block and formulation plant requirements.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Supriya Lifescience incurs a capex of INR 152 crore in FY26, primarily driven by Ambernath facility spends, maintenance capex, Ribo Block, and formulation plant requirements.

lab.quote: We are expecting about INR40 crores to INR50 crores of capex dedicated for the F block.

call_memory.quote: We are expecting about INR40 crores to INR50 crores of capex dedicated for the F block.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Supriya Lifescience plans to add 150 to 200 KL capacity at F block in Lote Parshuram over the next 2 years with a capex of INR 40 crore to INR 50 crore.

lab.quote: And the peak that we expect is about INR60 crores, which we'll be able to see in FY27.

call_memory.quote: And the peak that we expect is about INR60 crores, which we'll be able to see in FY27.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: DSM contract revenue contributed INR 30 to 35 crore in FY26, with an expected peak revenue of INR 60 crore in FY27.

lab.quote: But we have some indication from them that the audit would be scheduled in H2 of FY27.

call_memory.quote: But we have some indication from them that the audit would be scheduled in H2 of FY27.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: EU-GMP audit for Ambernath facility is expected to be scheduled in H2 FY27.

lab.quote: I think the average will be somewhere between 24 to 25.17%, that would be the rate you will be landing to.

call_memory.quote: I think the average will be somewhere between 24 to 25.17%, that would be the rate you will be landing to.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Effective tax rate for full year FY27 is expected to be between 24% and 25.17%.

lab.quote: We are looking at around 170 to 180 days going forward.

call_memory.quote: We are looking at around 170 to 180 days going forward.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Net working capital days going forward are targeted to be around 170 to 180 days.

lab.quote: So, at this point, we have already gone to full backward integration because when the volumes scaled up, we were waiting for the volumes to scale up, now that the volumes have scaled up, we have already fully backward integrated.

call_memory.quote: So, at this point, we have already gone to full backward integration because when the volumes scaled up, we were waiting for the volumes to scale up, now that the volumes have scaled up, we have already fully backward integrated.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Supriya Lifescience Limited has already fully backward integrated now that the volumes have scaled up.

timeline.summary: On April 22, 2026, Supriya Lifescience announced it received a USFDA EIR with VAI status for its Lote manufacturing facility following a February inspection.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹276.53 Cr (+50.2% YoY), net profit ₹74.23 Cr (+47.3% YoY).
Supriya Lifescience reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹276.53 Cr and net profit of ₹74.23 Cr.
On May 28, 2026, Supriya Lifescience reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹277 Cr (+50% YoY) and full-year FY26 revenue of ₹828 Cr (+18.9% YoY) with an EBITDA margin of 35.5%.
Supriya Lifescience announced that the Supreme Court has admitted its judicial proceedings and granted interim protection from coercive action.
